test.title: A goal you would like to achieve in the next few years

document.cue: Describe a goal you would like to achieve in the next few years.

text: One goal I'd really like to achieve in the next five years is to open a small bookshop café in my hometown, Taraz.

The idea first came to me about two years ago, when I spent a semester in Almaty and discovered a place that sold second-hand books in English and Kazakh alongside really good coffee. I used to spend hours there, and I remember thinking that nothing like that existed back home, where young people mostly meet in shopping malls.

At the moment I'm taking small but practical steps. I work part-time as a barista, so I'm learning how a café actually runs, from ordering supplies to dealing with difficult customers. I'm also saving a fixed amount every month, and I've started collecting books from friends who are moving or clearing out their shelves.

The reason it matters so much to me is that I'd love to give something back to my town. There aren't many quiet, friendly places where teenagers can read or study outside school, and I think a space like that could genuinely change how some of them spend their free time.
Of course, I know it's risky and it might take longer than I expect, but even if it stays small, I'd rather try and fail than always wonder what might have happened.

tips.en: I'm learning, I'm saving show actions in progress now.
tips.kk: I'm learning, I'm saving — қазір жүріп жатқан әрекеттер.
tips.ru: I'm learning, I'm saving — действия, которые идут сейчас.
tips.example: I'm also saving a fixed amount every month

tips.en: I'd rather try and fail than … is a memorable final line.
tips.kk: I'd rather try and fail than … — есте қалатын сөйлем.
tips.ru: I'd rather try and fail than … — запоминающаяся фраза.
tips.example: I'd rather try and fail than always wonder what might have happened

note.en: The goal and the time frame come in the first sentence, with no warm-up.
note.kk: Мақсат пен мерзім — бірінші сөйлемде, ұзақ кіріспесіз.
note.ru: Цель и срок — в первой фразе, без разгона.

note.en: When the idea came — told through a story and a contrast with home.
note.kk: Идея қашан пайда болды — оқиға және туған қаламен салыстыру арқылы.
note.ru: Когда появилась идея — через историю и контраст с родным городом.

note.en: What I am doing now — three concrete steps.
note.kk: Қазір не істеп жүрмін — үш нақты қадам.
note.ru: Что делаю сейчас — три конкретных шага.

note.en: Why it matters — a benefit for others, not only for the speaker.
note.kk: Неге маңызды — өзіне ғана емес, басқаларға да пайда.
note.ru: Почему важно — польза для других, а не только для себя.

note.en: Admitting the risk and ending with a strong sentence.
note.kk: Тәуекелді мойындау және күшті соңғы сөйлем.
note.ru: Признание риска и сильная финальная фраза.
